steps.name: panel-exclusive-zone
steps.subject: Top panel: keep the layer-shell exclusive zone equal to the panel thickness
steps.description:
Android cutout metadata can change the top panel's thickness after its first Wayland configure.
Resizing the visible panel alone left the original exclusive zone, so applications kept the old
reserved area. The panel now sets its layer-shell exclusion zone to its real thickness whenever
the thickness, visibility mode or floating state changes.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [a thickness change after the first configure is not Android specific; check upstream master first]

steps.name: convergent-keyboard
steps.subject: convergentwindows: do not reapply MaximizeArea to borderless windows (keyboard avoidance)
steps.description:
The direct resize only works around a decoration change. Once a window is borderless KWin owns its
maximized geometry, including the room the on-screen keyboard takes; reapplying MaximizeArea on
every activation discarded that keyboard avoidance. currentWindow also starts from the active window.

steps.name: navigation-accessible-names
steps.subject: Navigation panel buttons have accessible names
steps.description:
NavigationPanelAction.accessibleText, bound to Accessible.name, so assistive technology and AT-SPI
automation can tell Task switcher, Home and Close app apart.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: L3:app.launch (presses Home by its accessible name)

steps.name: marquee-stop-when-hidden
steps.subject: MarqueeLabel: stop the marquee while the quick settings are hidden; no mask when the text fits
steps.description:
Quick settings labels whose text overflowed kept their marquee animation running while the panel
was closed, so plasmashell advanced animations about 100 times a second on a static desktop
(8.5-10.5% of a core). Context-only differences against 6.6.5 were merged by hand.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: L3:perf.compositor (plasmashell CPU on an idle desktop)

steps.name: kscreenosd-read-config
steps.subject: kscreenosd: read the KScreen configuration at startup
steps.description:
KScreenOSDUtil never called retrieveKScreen(), so its output count stayed 0 and plugging a display
never switched to convergence (docked) mode.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [a plain bug; check upstream master first]

steps.name: predock-mode-apart
steps.subject: KScreenOSDProvider: keep the mode from before docking apart from convergenceModeEnabled
steps.description:
The mode from before a display was plugged in was read back from convergenceModeEnabled itself, so
a shell restarted while docked stayed docked after unplugging. The auto-dock state and the earlier
mode now live in their own settings.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: needs a shell restart while an external screen is connected)

steps.name: external-screen-desktop-shell
steps.subject: External screens get a desktop shell; the phone keeps the mobile shell
steps.description:
Upstream puts a second Folio home screen and no panels on external screens (desktop panels there
are only in the unmerged draft !548). An idempotent shell script (contents/external-desktop.js), run
by KScreenOSDUtil when a screen is added, gives every screen after the phone a Folder View desktop
and a Plasma Desktop panel. Applets of desktop panels and desktops use Plasma Desktop's AppletPopup
next to the panel instead of the mobile full-screen overlay.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [interim until upstream desktop panels on external screens (!548)]
dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: L3:cast.agent_screen (output appears); desktop shell on the TV: manual

steps.name: docked-rules-per-output
steps.subject: convergentwindows: docked window rules per output
steps.description:
Docked mode applied to every window, so connecting a TV gave the phone's apps title bars and
unmaximized geometry. Windows on the internal screen keep the mobile rules, windows on external
screens get desktop rules; a window moving between screens is re-evaluated, and one maximized for
the phone gets a centered desktop geometry on the TV.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: needs a window on the TV; manual)

steps.name: activate-on-tapped-screen
steps.subject: Tapping a running app's icon brings its window to the screen tapped on
steps.description:
launchOrActivateApp only asked KWin to activate a window where it was, so an app moved to the TV
stayed there when its icon was tapped on the phone. The launcher passes the screen it was tapped on;
WindowUtil sends a window on another output there (org_kde_plasma_window.send_to_output) before
activating it. Used by the Folio home screen and the media controls.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: needs a window on the TV; manual)

steps.name: desktop-size-windows-on-tv
steps.subject: convergentwindows: an app's first window opened on the TV gets the desktop size
steps.description:
Applications size a new window from the primary screen, the phone (360 px wide), even when it opens
on the TV; WeChat's main window then used its narrow layout without the chat list. A new window on
an external screen gets the desktop size, like windows moved from the phone.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: needs a window on the TV; manual)

steps.name: home-hold-voice-assistant
steps.subject: Navigation panel: holding Home summons the voice assistant
steps.description:
Navigation panel buttons can be held (NavigationPanelAction.holdable): past Android's 400 ms
long-press time a held press emits held() instead of triggered(), and holdReleased() when the
finger lifts. The task panel sends Home held and lifted, with the screen, to the voice assistant
over D-Bus (asynchronous, harmless without it); a Home tap also sends Hide.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [calls this project's voice assistant; a holdable button alone could go upstream]

steps.name: desktop-size-first-window-only
steps.subject: fixup! convergentwindows: an app's first window opened on the TV gets the desktop size

steps.name: panels-app-colours
steps.subject: Status bar and navigation panel take the colours of the app shown
steps.description:
Apps give KWin their colour scheme (Window::colorScheme). The convergentwindows script reports the
scheme of the window activated on each screen to the shell (org.kde.plasmashell /Mobile
setActiveWindowColorScheme), and the panels use its Header/Window background, with light content on
a dark one. Apps without a scheme of their own keep the theme's panels.

dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: no scenario compares panel colours)

steps.name: desktop-size-comment
steps.subject: fixup! convergentwindows: an app's first window opened on the TV gets the desktop size

steps.name: recording-quicksetting
steps.subject: Recording quick setting: this project's recorder (KWin screencast stream, shared codec)
steps.description:
The quick setting records the KWin screencast stream through the shared Android codec instead of
KPipeWire. Its sources are this repository's plasma/recording, placed into quicksettings/record by
the recipe's overlay (they replace recordutil.* and the QML wholesale); this patch builds them.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [uses the Android hardware codec bridge of this project]
